[LIMP.3.1.4] **Dotted-path resolution.** A dotted import
`import a.b.c` resolves by walking the segments as
directory names against the search path, with the final
segment matched as the `.ds` filename. For search path
entry `<root>`, the candidate file is `<root>/a/b/c.ds`.
The resolver checks each search-path entry in order; the
first match wins. Intermediate directories that do not
exist on a given root simply mean no match at that root —
the resolver continues to the next entry.
